work.description: Letter CLXVIII to Archbishop Gousset of Reims on the diversity of liturgical books in France; address, intitulation, body and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF31964–31964; the source dating clause at LF32038–32041 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem die sexta augusti anni millesimi octingen- tesimi quadragesimi secundi, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
